purpose: Slugs whose LEARNED signature is known to be the wrong person. The audit drops the learned clusters for these and uses the hand-picked /admin/faces crop instead. Without this, saved_crop_anchors skips anyone who already has a learned signature, so a corrected crop would never reach the recognition profile. Keep this list short and evidenced: it overrides multi-photo learning with a single frame. A correction is a stopgap, not a fix. When the clustering finally learns the right face, retire it here rather than leaving it to quietly discard a good signature.

resolved.wasWrongBecause: Every face in his learned cluster (c0259, 5 faces across 5 photos) was a woman with a chin-length bob and large square sunglasses; his committed saved face is a heavyset man. The cluster was named on thin evidence (support 2, soloSupport 1, confidence 0.325, from only 4 tagged photos), and after the 2026-08-05 rebuild it began winning the archive's three highest untagged matches, which would have put his name on three photographs of somebody else.
resolved.resolution: The woman is Dominique Caron, his companion, seated guest, previously zero tagged photographs. Same defect shape as the Gutierrezes: a couple photographed together where only one identity ever resolved, so co-occurrence handed her face to his name. Zach identified her from the cluster contact sheet (wave 13); tagging her five photographs let the next rebuild assign c0259 to her (confidence 0.451) and give Mike his own genuine cluster c0305 (4 faces, confidence 0.381), visually verified against his saved thumbnail. Retired per this file's own rule rather than left to discard his now-good signature.
resolved.keptAnchors: He never had a hand-picked crop; both identities now run on learned signatures.

resolved.wasWrongBecause: The learned signature was Chris Gutierrez, her husband. chris-gutierrez had no learned signature of his own, so co-occurrence naming attached his face cluster to her slug. Confirmed three ways: her committed saved face and his were the same man; the face Zach identified as Maura scored 0.655 against that signature's own top match and nothing else above 0.183; and Zach confirmed all eleven archive faces matching his pick, nine of which sat in photos already tagged to her.
resolved.resolution: Rebuilding signatures after waves 5-7 separated the couple. The two tags added for her in wave 7 gave co-occurrence enough signal to name them apart, and Chris earned a signature of his own for the first time. Hers now scores 0.720 against the anchor face Zach picked and 0.060 against Chris's; his scores 0.849 against his own face and 0.021 against hers. Both are learned from many photos (17 and 9 faces), which is stronger evidence than the single crop this correction substituted, so it was retired rather than left in place to discard a good signature.
resolved.keptAnchors: Both still have hand-picked /admin/faces crops backing their guest-facing thumbnails. Only the recognition override was retired.
